newsitem.title: FRANCE: Dassault gets order for 13 Rafale.
newsitem.headline: Dassault gets order for 13 Rafale.

text.p: The government has ordered 13 Rafale fighter planes from Dassault Aviation for the navy and the Air Force, an official at the Defence Ministry said.
It concerns 10 Rafale for the Navy and three two-seat versions for the Air Force to be delivered from 1999.

The Rafale programme had been held up since November 1995 pending negotiations between the defence procurement office and the companies of the Rafale programme -- Dassault, Thomson-CSF and Snecma -- over a 10 percent price reduction.
The current centre-right government intends to order 48 Rafale planes.

The opposition Socialist Party said in a recent report it would order an audit into the costs of the Rafale programme of some 20 billion francs. The price of one Rafale is estimated at some 300 million francs.
